inputs.prompt: A woman sits at her desk in a bright office by day, on a video call, seen by her laptop's webcam. She listens to a colleague giving an update: she looks at her screen just below the lens with a calm, interested face and blinks naturally. She listens closely, gives a small nod, and smiles slightly. Her lips stay closed: she does not speak at any time. Small natural movements only, like a real person listening on a video call. Her hands stay out of the picture. Nobody enters the picture and nobody walks past behind her. The camera is a fixed laptop webcam: the framing does not change at all. At the end she is back in the same pose as at the start, looking at her screen. One continuous shot with no cuts, no zoom, no pan, no music, no subtitles and no text.

expect.basis: WP3 paid about $0.17 for a 5 s take at 768P on this route (the hand-off); the dry run shows the live price

note: Draft 3 (V20): Amara listens on the Zoom call, a loop on the tile still (first and last frame), so nobody is frozen while the Peer speaks (wp2-6)
